scope: Initial assistant review of the synthetic rules-based development baseline. Same assistant authored the cases; this is not an independent human review, LLM evaluation or held-out accuracy estimate.
limitations: Fictional development cases reviewed by the same assistant that wrote them, not independent human review or unseen test results.
The rules provider copies excerpts. This does not measure free-form model summaries or automatic reporting-group detection.
Reviews apply only to the recorded run hashes; later outputs need review.
next_action: Add explicit conflict detection and an unresolved-conflict signal before claiming corroboration across incompatible reports. Keep both attributed accounts. Test that conflicting and agreeing reports produce different signals.
